newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine raises '97 sunseed forecast to 2.5 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine raises '97 sunseed forecast to 2.5 mln T.

text.p: Ukraine has raised its 1997 sunflowerseed output forecast to 2.5 million tonnes from 2.3 million estimated previously, Interfax news agency quoted a senior agriculture official as saying on Friday.
The agency gave no reason for the revision, which it attributed to Deputy Prime Minister in charge of agriculture Mikhailo Zubets.
Ukraine produced 2.04 million tonnes of sunflowerseed in 1996, down sharply from 1995's 2.75 million tonnes.
Ukraine is a major exporter of sunflowerseed to Europe and sends some to Russia. Independent agricultural analysts' forecasts for the 1997 harvest run as high as 2.90 million tonnes.
